lines: Good evening. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
‘Code Grey’ declared at Toronto hospital network amid Microsoft outage, The Canadian Press reports.
Scandal-hit Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang quits, plunging AI chipmaking giant into turmoil, BBC News reports.

U.S. envoys met Thursday with Russian President Vladimir Putin in the Kremlin before heading to Ireland for talks with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy as Washington sought new momentum for its peace efforts, The Associated Press reports.

President Donald Trump on Thursday heaped praise on Mississippi’s Sen.-elect Scott Colom for courting some of his hardcore MAGA supporters in the final days of the midterm, The Associated Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
